verdict.rationale: Granola's own model-training doc says users can opt out of model training in Settings, at any time, which directly lets a user keep their data out of training. The evidence is only two short first-party statements. missing for 10: detail on what the opt-out covers (e.g. third-party model providers, transcripts vs notes), whether it is opt-in or opt-out by default, admin/workspace-wide enforcement, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: You can opt out of model training in Settings.
You can opt out of model training at any time.
